newsitem.title: USA: U.S. court sets schedule for Hilton appeal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. court sets schedule for Hilton appeal.

text.p: A federal appellate court denied an expedited hearing of Hilton Hotels Corp's appeal of a lower court ruling in its $6.5 billion takeover battle for ITT Corp and set a schedule for the filing of briefs.
The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth District, based in San Francisco, on Thursday said answering briefs were due May 27 and optional reply briefs within 14 days of service of the answering brief.
An official at the court clerk's office said the appellate court would set a hearing date after the filing of briefs.

Hilton had asked the district court in Las Vegas to compel ITT to hold its annual meeting in mid-May. Hilton has nominated a slate of directors to ITT's board in an attempt to unseat its current members.
A U.S. district judge denied Hilton's motion in April.
ITT has yet to set a date for the meeting and could take until mid-November to do so.
Hilton launched its $55-per-share cash and stock bid for ITT in late January. ITT rejected the bid, calling it inadequate.
